common_base.review_task: Starting from the observed downstream execution and final result, determine whether a behaviorally significant fault exists anywhere in the two-job chain. Review the downstream boundaries first, trace to the upstream producer when the supplied evidence supports it, and return one top root-cause boundary from either job or no suspect.

expected_outputs: coverage DataFrame with record_id, need, capability_id, and coverage
semantic_declarations.role: Map each allowed handoff need to direct capability coverage while tolerating missing capability fields.

expected_outputs: priorities DataFrame with one ranked priority record per need
semantic_declarations.role: Rank unsupported needs ahead of directly covered needs using upstream provenance rank as the within-group ordering key.

expected_outputs: recommendation dictionary with top_need and decision
semantic_declarations.role: Retain the bounded priority window and construct the recommendation directly from the already-ranked first priority record.

expected_inputs: corpus DataFrame with record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight columns
expected_outputs: DataFrame of selected need records built from appended dictionary literals
semantic_declarations.role: Select demanded corpus records while retaining explicit fallback records through the returned data path.

expected_outputs: normalized needs DataFrame preserving allowed existing record identifiers
semantic_declarations.role: Normalize selected evidence records to the bounded allowed record window with neutral JSON-safe sentinels.

expected_outputs: evidence_sources DataFrame with record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank
semantic_declarations.role: Assemble source provenance by missing-safe field access and demand-ranked ordering.
